activity.notes: Frederick I was elected King of Denmark in 1523 and ruled until his death in 1533. This Danish kingship is distinct from both his Schleswig-Holstein co-ducal rule and his Norwegian kingship.

sources.title: Frederik 1. – konge 1524–1533 — Store norske leksikon
sources.citation_text: Store norske leksikon states that Frederick I was King of Denmark from 1523 to 1533 and King of Norway from 1524 to 1533.
